acquisition method: MS data were acquired in a data-dependent mode, with target values of 3E+06 and 1E+05 or 5E+04 for MS and MS/MS scans, respectively, and a top-10 method.
alkylation concentration: alkylated using 50 mM iodoacetamide... alkylated with 15 mM iodoacetamide... alkylated with 5 mM iodoacetamide
cleavage agent: overnight digestion with Lys-C-Trypsin mix (1:100 enzyme to protein ratio) and trypsin
fractionation method: strong anion exchange (SAX) chromatography, strong cation exchange (SCX) chromatography
separated into six fractions using strong anion exchange (SAX) chromatography... separated into five fractions using strong cation exchange (SCX) chromatography
instrument: high-resolution LC-MS/MS analysis on the Q-Exactive Plus or HF mass spectrometers
labeling: followed with stable isotope labeling with amino acids in cell culture (SILAC)-based high-resolution LC-MS/MS analysis... label-free quantification normalization data were used
reduction concentration: reduced using 100 mM DTT... reduced using 5 mM DTT... reduced with 1 mM DTT
